original_test_intent: Validate InfiniBand latency and write-bandwidth performance between two approved hosts under a controlled HCA/port/transport profile and compare repeatable results with the NIC specification.
original_method: Record endpoints, HCA/port/GID/LID/IPoIB/link/MTU/firmware/OFED/perftest/NUMA and baseline counters/logs; approve required modules and isolated fabric; verify reachability; select RC/UC/UD and latency/bandwidth message/queue/iteration/duration/repetition profile; run paired ibv_rc_pingpong and/or ib_write_bw server/client commands with explicit peer; capture all runs and averages; collect final counters/logs, stop processes and restore module/network state.
manual_activity: IB owners select latency/bandwidth scope, transport/profile, HCA/port/peer/fabric and thresholds; agent may validate modules and run the approved endpoint pair.
required_inputs: Firmware/driver/OFED/libibverbs/perftest versions and production-safe fabric isolation
Latency versus bandwidth or both, RC/UC/UD, message size, queue, iterations/duration, repetitions and averaging method
NIC-specific latency/bandwidth/error thresholds and comparable link/MTU/NUMA conditions
Approved module/IPoIB changes, abort and cleanup/recovery policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated or owner-approved IB fabric and peer
Verify exact HCA/port/path and compatible tool versions before traffic
Load/unload modules or alter IPoIB only under approved recovery procedure
Stop on wrong path, counter/error storm, link flap, peer instability or production impact
No automatic retry; preserve failed evidence and restore only approved settings
agent_execution_scope: Validate endpoints, modules, fabric/profile and baseline counters/logs
Run the approved paired latency/bandwidth profile and repetitions
Compute only the approved aggregate and verify final health/restoration
Do not choose mode/profile/spec, omit latency silently, change production fabric/modules independently, rerun or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Provide comparable NIC thresholds and abort/recovery policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incomplete and unsafe: module loads plus peerless `ib_write_bw -d mlx5_0` do not create a server/client test, omit the source latency path and repetitions, truncate output and use insecure SSH.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After approved setup, run `ibv_rc_pingpong` server plus explicit client for the selected latency profile and `ib_write_bw` server plus explicit peer client for the selected bandwidth profile, using release-correct device/port/mode options and preserving every full run for the approved average.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Source module readiness, IPoIB reachability, latency and bandwidth server/client coverage, multiple tests/averaging, possible RC/UC/UD selection and final link check are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Execute separately identified paired latency and bandwidth profiles with mapped HCA/port counters and reproducible aggregates.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Pins identities, tool versions, options, repetitions, thresholds, safety gates and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single local ib_write_bw tail cannot cover latency, peer transport, repetition/average or final fabric health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Perftest results vary materially with mode, message size, queue depth, GID/MTU, PCIe/NUMA and CPU affinity; comparisons require matching conditions.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must decide whether both latency and bandwidth are mandatory and which modes are in scope. Loading IPoIB modules is not proof of RDMA performance and may not be needed for native verbs addressing; do not infer configuration from examples.
expected_evidence: SUT/peer HCA/port/GID/LID/IPoIB/fabric identities and link state
Exact paired latency and/or bandwidth commands and complete outputs for each repetition
Before/after authoritative IB counters and host/peer/system logs
Restored module/network state, versioned threshold comparison and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source is broad but coherent: it describes latency and bandwidth tests and optional mode exploration. Unspecified selection parameters are decision gaps, not contradictory source identity or criteria.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Compatible packages, peer, profile and thresholds can be supplied; the static multi-test intent is identifiable.

review_improvement: Restores the omitted latency and repetition coverage and makes endpoint, transport, module-state and acceptance dependencies explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: A verbs performance command must form a compatible two-endpoint connection; a serverless invocation cannot measure the intended path. Latency and bandwidth exercise different data paths and options, while RC/UC/UD, message size, queue depth, GID/MTU and NUMA placement change results. Reproducible averages require pinned profiles and complete per-run evidence, not a tailed local output.
